articles.title: India-Brazil bilateral trade set to reach $20 bn with focus on critical minerals, AI, defence: Envoy
articles.description: Brazil's Ambassador to India highlighted growing trade relations, expecting bilateral trade to reach USD 20 billion soon. The partnership encompasses critical sectors such as defence, energy, and pharmaceuticals, promoting economic engagement. Both nations aim to deepen cultural ties, celebrating the centenary of musician Antonio Carlos Jobim in 2027. Recent political visits strengthened commitments toward technological and economic cooperation in multilateral forums.

articles.title: Thailand's economy improves in September on AI-driven exports
articles.description: BANGKOK: Thailand's economy improved overall in September on a monthly basis, as the global artificial intelligence (AI) boom lifted electronics exports and data-centre investment, though tourism and consumer spending weakened, the central bank said on Friday (Oct 30).
